newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares firm, but AEX index held below 800.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares firm, but AEX index held below 800.

text.p: 1035 GMT - Dutch shares were still firm at midsession, but the AEX index held below 800 points after breaking through that mark at the opening. Expiring options were seen as one reason for market's reluctance to push higher.
* AEX index up 3.44 points, or 0.43 percent to 798.46, off opening high of 801.27.
* Nedlloyd one of larger risers after P&O Nedlloyd chairman said on Thursday that cost savings in container shipping are on course. Shares up 1.70 guilders to 49.20.
